description: A pharmacy has two factories, factory 1 and factory 2, where they make acne cream and anti-bacterial cream. Factory 1 produces 12 units of acne cream and 15 units of anti-bacterial cream per hour. Factory 2 produces 20 units of acne cream and 10 units of anti-bacterial cream per hour. Factory 1 requires 30 units of base gel per hour while factory 2 requires 45 units of base gel per hour. The pharmacy has available 5000 units of base gel. Further, they must make at least 800 units of acne cream and 1000 units of anti-bacterial cream. How many hours should each factory be run to minimize the total time needed?

ProductionRate.definition: Production rate of a product by a factory in units per hour

BaseGelRequirement.definition: Base gel required per hour by a factory

AvailableBaseGel.definition: Total available units of base gel

MinimumDemand.definition: Minimum required units of each product

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of hours that factory 1 and factory 2 are operated"

constraints.description: 30 times the hours run of factory 1 plus 45 times the hours run of factory 2 should not exceed 5000 units of base gel
12 times the hours run of factory 1 plus 20 times the hours run of factory 2 should be at least 800 units of acne cream
15 times the hours run of factory 1 plus 10 times the hours run of factory 2 should be at least 1000 units of anti-bacterial cream
The hours run of factory 1 should be non-negative
The hours run of factory 2 should be non-negative
